visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins with a close-up shot of a young woman sitting on a white bed inside a futuristic, transparent capsule-like room suspended against a sheer rock face. She has long brown hair and is wearing a light-colored sports bra and blue leggings, holding a white mug and looking out towards the camera. The capsule is constructed with a metallic frame and multiple circular windows, revealing a minimalist interior with white pillows and blankets. (2) As the camera begins a rapid drone-assisted zoom-out, the sheer scale of the vertical cliff becomes visible, characterized by rugged, reddish-brown rock formations and sparse green vegetation. The woman remains seated in the pod, which is anchored to the cliffside by thick steel cables. Narrow, zigzagging metal stairways are built into the cliff face, connecting different sections of the steep mountain terrain under bright, natural daylight. (3) The wide-angle shot reveals at least four identical glass pods vertically distributed along the mountain wall, resembling a vertical hotel. A second individual, wearing a bright red jacket, is seen walking up the steep metal stairs between two capsules. The overall environment is one of extreme height and isolated natural beauty, with the lighting appearing flat and consistent across the textured mountain surface.
